dsaPatterns.title: Arrays, Strings & Math
dsaPatterns.summary: The bread and butter of every screen: in-place updates, sorting tricks, and bit/number manipulation.
dsaPatterns.cheatSheet: Sort first, or use a running sum / hash map, before reaching for nested loops.

dsaPatterns.title: Hashing, Two Pointers & Sliding Window
dsaPatterns.summary: Turn O(N^2) scans into O(N) with frequency maps and moving windows.
dsaPatterns.cheatSheet: Expand the right edge, shrink the left edge when the constraint breaks.

dsaPatterns.title: Binary Search & Answer Space
dsaPatterns.summary: Search sorted data, rotated data, or the answer range itself.
dsaPatterns.cheatSheet: If a predicate flips from false to true once, binary search finds the boundary.

dsaPatterns.title: Linked Lists
dsaPatterns.summary: Pointer manipulation, cycle detection and list splicing.
dsaPatterns.cheatSheet: A dummy head node removes almost every head edge case.

dsaPatterns.title: Stacks, Queues & Monotonic Structures
dsaPatterns.cheatSheet: Keep the stack monotonic; pop while the incoming element breaks the order.

dsaPatterns.title: Trees & BSTs
dsaPatterns.summary: Recursive divide and conquer plus level-order traversal.
dsaPatterns.cheatSheet: Compute left, compute right, combine at the node, return to the parent.

dsaPatterns.title: Heaps & Priority Queues
dsaPatterns.summary: Track running extremes and top-K in O(log N).
dsaPatterns.cheatSheet: For the K largest, keep a min-heap of size K.

dsaPatterns.title: Graphs & Grid Traversal
dsaPatterns.summary: BFS/DFS, topological sort, shortest paths and union-find.
dsaPatterns.cheatSheet: BFS for unweighted shortest path; Dijkstra when edges carry weights.

dsaPatterns.title: Recursion & Backtracking
dsaPatterns.summary: Enumerate choices, prune early, undo state.
dsaPatterns.cheatSheet: Always undo the choice after the recursive call returns.

dsaPatterns.title: Greedy & Intervals
dsaPatterns.summary: Locally optimal choices that stay globally optimal.
dsaPatterns.cheatSheet: If you cannot argue why the local choice is safe, it is probably DP.

dsaPatterns.title: Dynamic Programming
dsaPatterns.summary: Optimal substructure and overlapping subproblems on arrays, strings and grids.
dsaPatterns.cheatSheet: Define dp[i] in one sentence, then express it only via earlier states.

dsaPhases.title: Core Patterns & Linear Data Structures
dsaPhases.description: Array, string, hashing, search and list patterns behind most screening rounds.

dsaPhases.title: Trees, Graphs, Heaps & Stacks
dsaPhases.description: Non-linear structures that dominate onsite coding loops.

atlassian.summary: The 8 stories every loop asks for in some form. Prepare these once, reuse everywhere.
concepts: Have a failure and a conflict story ready

practiceProblems.title: Tell me about yourself.
Walk me through a project you are most proud of.
Tell me about a time you failed.
Describe a conflict with a teammate and how you resolved it.
Tell me about a time you disagreed with your manager.
Tell me about the most technically challenging problem you solved.
Tell me about a time you influenced without authority.
Tell me about a time you had to make a decision with incomplete information.
